scenicChapters.title: Passo dello Spluga
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2114 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Passo dello Spluga

scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

splugen-pass-road.story: A 61 km one-way ride from near Hinterrhein, about 1 h 04 of riding. On the way it passes Splugen Pass and Montespluga. The highest point is about 2,200 m. Splugen Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
